events.name: Egg Expedition: The Crier
events.intro: A bell rings out across the square, again and again, until everyone looks up. Crier Bell stands on a crate with his hat in his hand and his cheeks red from shouting: "Breeders out in force! Eggs everywhere!" People are already hanging bunting. Somebody is selling something on a stick. It is that kind of week.

success.text: A breeder with a basket on each arm finds you before you finish saying yes. "Here. Keep it warm. It's been waiting for someone." The Egg is warm already, and it twitches.
Crier Bell leans down off his crate, delighted to be asked. "Breeders are on every road, and nests in every hedge. Join in, and one of them will press an Egg into your hands before you even ask."
You smile and keep walking. The week goes on around you anyway: you can hear the bell all the way out of town.

success.text: Something big and bright moves in the long grass, and does not want to be caught.

events.name: Hardcore Hour: The Challenge Board
events.intro: A board by the road, covered in pinned cards, and a big man in a leather apron leaning on it, chewing a straw. Grizzle, the board keeper, taps one card with a thick finger: "Bosses hit harder. Pay triple. Reward's on the card. Sign up, or don't; nobody'll think less of you."

success.text: Grizzle stamps your card so hard the table jumps. "Hardcore. Good. The bosses have been told." The rule holds for the region. Bosses deal a quarter more damage. Boss prize money ×3.
The card, in Grizzle's big square letters: "HARDCORE HOUR. Rule: Bosses deal a quarter more damage. Lasts: this region. Reward: Boss prize money ×3."
Grizzle shrugs, not unkindly, and goes back to his straw. "Next time, maybe."

events.name: Tailwind Week: The Challenge Board
events.intro: A board by the road, covered in pinned cards, and a big man in a leather apron leaning on it, chewing a straw. Grizzle, the board keeper, taps one card with a thick finger: "Steady wind at your back. Reward's on the card. Sign up, or don't; nobody'll think less of you."

success.text: "A kind week," says Grizzle. "Everyone needs one. Go on." The rule holds for the region. Your side has a Tailwind for the first turns of every battle. No extra reward: it's a breather.
The card, in Grizzle's big square letters: "TAILWIND WEEK. Rule: Your side has a Tailwind for the first turns of every battle. Lasts: this region. Reward: No extra reward: it's a breather."
Grizzle shrugs, not unkindly, and goes back to his straw. "Next time, maybe."

events.name: Solo Hero Week: Grizzle Pays Up
events.intro: The new region's first road, and Grizzle is waiting at the border with your card, stamped "SOLO HERO WEEK: DONE".

success.text: Grizzle finds you at the border with the card in his hand. "One Pokémon, one road, a whole region. Look at it." Your lead stands taller than it did. It is stronger, all over, and it knows it.

events.name: No Items Week: Grizzle Pays Up
events.intro: The new region's first road, and Grizzle is waiting at the border with your card, stamped "NO ITEMS WEEK: DONE".

success.text: Grizzle meets you at the border and cuts the string off your bag with a pocketknife. "A whole region with a locked bag. Here. You earned something nice to put back in it."

events.name: No Revival Week: Grizzle Pays Up
events.intro: The new region's first road, and Grizzle is waiting at the border with your card, stamped "NO REVIVAL WEEK: DONE".

success.text: Grizzle hands back the little box. "You looked after them. Every one." Your team crowds round you while he says it, as if they understood.

events.name: Only Starters Week: Grizzle Pays Up
events.intro: The new region's first road, and Grizzle is waiting at the border with your card, stamped "ONLY STARTERS WEEK: DONE".

success.text: Grizzle has a basket at the border with an Egg in it, and a tag: "Starter. Unknown. Warm." "Somebody's first partner, one day," he says. "Might be yours."

events.name: Only Unevolved Week: Grizzle Pays Up
events.intro: The new region's first road, and Grizzle is waiting at the border with your card, stamped "ONLY UNEVOLVED WEEK: DONE".

success.text: Grizzle checks your card at the border and laughs out loud. "Look at them. Look how they've grown." They have.
